children: Mirion Technologies approved a $250 million share repurchase program and repurchased about $40 million of Class A stock in Q3 2026.
Board authorized a new 2026 Repurchase Program to buy up to $250 million of Class A common stock through Aug 31, 2031.
In Q3 2026 the company repurchased ~2.6 million shares for ~ $40 million, substantially completing its prior $100 million program.
Repurchases may occur via open market, negotiated or block trades subject to Rule 10b-18 and other constraints.
Timing, amounts and prices of future buybacks depend on market conditions, debt covenants and other factors; program may be suspended or terminated.
